Price doesn't move randomly. It hunts VOLUME. 🧲

The POC (point of control) is where most volume traded = fair value. When price runs far from it, the odds favor a return — not a breakout you chase at the top.

1️⃣ Mark the POC & value area
2️⃣ Never chase far from it
3️⃣ Target the return
